translation.name: An it jilchith cau cʼal i Ajatic Jesucristo

book.name: SAN LUCAS
book.title: An alhua’ cau thuchath c’al an t’ocat inic Lucas

content: In eyaltal a Jesús

Jun a q’uicha c’uajat a Jesús ti al am pulic tiyopan ti Jerusalén in olnanchal an inicchic an alhua’ cau, ani ulits c’al jaja’ i oc’lec pale’chic ani i exobchixchic c’al an ts’ejcath cau binath c’al a Moisés ani i yejtselabchic Israel.
Ani conoyab a Jesús: ―¿Jita’ ti pithamal an eyaltalab ani jita’ ti abamal abal ca t’aja’ jahua’ a t’ajal?
Toc’tsin a Jesús: ―Nana’ne ne’ets tu conoychic c’al jun i cau ani u le’ abal tiquin toc’tsinchi.
¿C’al jita’ ti aban a Juan ti pujax? Tiquin toc’tsinchi, max c’al a Dios o max c’al i inic.

Tam jaja’chic in t’iloxnachiquiyal jahua’ in ulu a Jesús, ani taley in uluchic: ―¿Jant’ini’ ti qui toc’tsinchi? Max qui ulu abal c’al a Dios jats ti abnenec a Juan ti pujax, tam jaja’ ne’ets quin ulu abal jale’ yab i belchamal in cahuintal.
Max qui ulu abal c’al i inic jats ti abnenec, tam patal an inicchic ne’ets tucu cui’iy c’al i t’ujub ma tucu tsemtha’, cum in lej belalits abal a Juan pel i lej chubax caulome abnenec c’al a Dios.
Tam tocat in toc’tsiychic abal yab in tso’ob c’al jita’ ti abnenec a Juan ti pujax.
Tam a Jesús in ucha’chic: ―Nana’ne yab ne’ets tu olchichic c’al jita’ tim pithnenec u eyaltal ani c’al jita’ tin abnenec.
An jalpith cau c’al am pocax t’ojonchixchic
Taley a Jesús in olchiye an inicchic q’ue’at i jalpith cau antse’: ―Jun i inic in t’aya’ jun i lab t’uthublom. Taley im bina’ c’al jita’ ta ca t’ojonchat. Tam c’ale an thabal ti ohuat c’uajil pil.

Taley im bajuhuits in q’uijil an cotlats c’al an lab t’uthub, ani an thabal in aba’ jun i t’ojnal ca c’ale quim bats’c’unchi an lab t’uthub axi ne’ets ca jilc’on abal jaja’ an thabal. Ulits jaja’, ani tocat cuathan ani aban ca huichiy naptal c’al an thabal.
Tam an thabal in aba’ ca c’ale q’ue’at i t’ojnal. Jayetseq’ui cuathan ani quithab uchan, ani aban ca huichiy naptal c’al an thabal.
Taley an thabal in aba’ q’ue’ate i t’ojnal, ani jayetseq’ui ts’ojbetha ani quethmayat ca c’ale.
Taley in ulu an thabal: ¿Jant’o ne’ets cu t’aja’ xo’? Ne’ets cu lejat aba’ u ichich hual tsacamil. Hualam jaja’ ojni’ ne’ets ca c’ac’nacua’.
Ani iba, expith in ulu an t’ojonchixchic antse’: Jats axe’ ne’ets ti c’alnanchix c’al an lab t’uthublom tam ca tsemets in tata. Qui tsemtha’ abal qui c’alnanchi huahua’.
Tam in caltha’ tin elebtal an t’uthublom, ani in t’ajat tsemtha’. Tam a Jesús in conoyal: ―¿Jant’ini’ ti ne’ets quin t’ajchi an thabal lab t’uthublom nixe’ xi t’ojonchixchic?

Ne’ets ca c’ale quin t’ajat tsemtha’chic, ani ne’ets quim bina’ an lab t’uthublom ca t’ojonchat c’al q’ue’at i t’ojonchix. Tam tin ats’a’its axi taja’chic antsana’ in ulu a Jesús, in uluchic: ―Iba a Dios yab quin jila’ antsana’ ca tsemthachic.
Ani a Jesús tocat in met’alchic ani in ulu: ―Auxe’ max yab nana’ ax u olnab ti al an T’ocat Thuchlab ejtil in mimlab t’ujub. In thuchathits antse’:

content.text: An ts’ejcom atachic in ulu yab jant’o ti alhua’ axe’ xi t’ujub, ani tocat im pet’na’.
Ani ja’its nix an t’ujub axi punuthits ti mimlab t’ujub.

content: Ejtil an inic axi ca ijcan al i t’ujub ani ca yajchiquiyat, antsana’ jitats yab tim belal nana’. Ejtil max ca ijcanchat i t’ujub ani ca tsemtha i inic, antsana’ jitats yab tim belal nana’.
An jalbixtalab tumin c’al an gobierno

C’al nixe’ xi cau an oc’lec pale’chic ani an exobchixchic c’al an ts’ejcath cau binath c’al a Moisés in le’ quin yac’ua’ a Jesús, cum in exlalits abal jaja’chic ax u olnab al nixe’ xi jalpith cau. Expith in ts’ejnalchic max jant’o ca t’ajchin c’al am bichouchic max quin lej yac’ua’ a Jesús.

Tam in aba’chic talchic i inic ax in timc’oyal tim ba’ abal jaja’ alhua’, quin cuatsith t’ajchi ti cuenta a Jesús max quin q’uibts’oth ulu i cau, ani antsana’ ca ejtohuat ca jolbiyat ani ca bina tin c’ubac an gobernador.

Ulitschic ani uchan a Jesús: ―Exobchix, i tso’ob abal jahua’ tata’ ca ulu ani ca exobchi pel i lej chubaxtalab. Yab it poc’oth tsu’tom c’al an inic, ani c’al patal an inicchic a olnanchal in tequeth belil a Dios.
Tucu ucha’ max i cua’al i uchbil o max yab i cua’al qui jalbiy an jalbixtalab tumin c’al an ts’ale oc’lec romano.
Cum a Jesús in exlanchits in c’ambixtal, jaxtam in toc’tsiychic antse’: ―¿Jale’ a le’chic tiquin macla’?
Qui met’a jun i tumin. ¿Jita’ axe’ in hual ani jita’ axe’ im bij axi thuchath teje’ al an tumin? ―Toc’tsinchic: ―Pel in hual ani pel im bij an ts’ale oc’lec.
Tam a Jesús in ucha’chic: ―Ca pitha’ an ts’ale oc’lec jahua’ pel a uchbil ca pitha’, ani ca pitha’ a Dios jahua’ pel a uchbil ca pitha’ jaye.
Axi che’nec ti maclaxchic yab in ejtou ni hue’ quin macla’ a Jesús c’al jahua’ in toc’tsinchi tin tamet an inicchic. Tocat in jic’panchalchic in toc’tsixtal, ani lejat ts’ibc’anchic.
Conoyab a Jesús tin cuenta abal ne’ets ca ejtha an tsemelomchic
Taley chich talchic i saduceo quin tsu’u a Jesús. Cum yab im belalchic abal max ne’ets ca ejtha an tsemelomchic, jaxtam uchan a Jesús c’al jaja’chic:

―Exobchix, in thucha’ a Moisés abal max ca tsemets jun i tomquith inic ani yab in co’oyamal i tsacam c’al in q’uimathil, ca tomquin in ebchal an tsemelom c’al an tsemchith uxum. Lequitsq’ui max quin co’oy i tsacam tam.
Hua’atsac buc i ebchalab. Tomquin an oc’ox, ani tsemets yab in co’oyamal i tsacam.
Taley tomquin in tsabchil ebchal an tsemelom c’al an tsemchith uxum. Tsemets jaja’, ani yab in co’oyamal i tsacam.

Taley tomquin in oxchil ebchal an tsemelom c’al an tsemchith uxum. Tim patal nixe’ xi buc i ebchalab tomquinenec c’al nixe’ xi uxum juncats, ani tim patal tsemets ani ni jun yab in co’oyamal i tsacam.
Taley tsemets jaye an uxum.
¿Cum tomquinenec nixe’ xi uxum c’al axi buc i ebchalab teje’ tsabal, c’al jahua’ ti ne’ets ca c’uajiy ti tomiclab tam ca ejtha an tsemelomchic?
Tam a Jesús in toc’tsiychic: ―U tomquinal an inic ani an uxum expith teje’ tsabal.
Tam ca ejtha an tsemelomchic axi jec’onthach, in ey an inic ani in ey an uxum yabats ne’ets ca tomquin.
Ne’ets ca ejthachic c’al a Dios tin lej tsacamilchic, ani ne’ets ca c’uajiy ejtil an ángelchic yab u tomquinal. Tihua’ ti eb ni jayq’ui’ yab ne’ets ca tsemetschic.

A Moisés in olna’ jant’ini’ ti tauna jaja’ c’al a Dios ti al i tsacam te’ tam ti t’a’ilits, ani c’al in cahuintal i tso’obits abal ne’ets ca ejtha an tsemelomchic. Uchan abal a Dios pel in Diosil a Abraham ani in Diosil a Isaac ani in Diosil a Jacobcua’.
Cum a Dios pel in Diosil nixe’ xi ox i inic axi tsemenec teje’ tsabal, i exlalits abal bel c’uajatchic ejate tin tamet a Dios. A Dios in tsu’tal abal ejate patal an inicchic.
Tam uchan a Jesús c’al talchic i exobchix c’al an ts’ejcath cau binath c’al a Moisés: ―Exobchix, lej chubax an cau jahua’ a ulumal.
Ma tamits ni jita’ yab in inicnal tim ba’ abal quin conomichiquiye a Jesús c’al más i cau.
In ey a Cristo
Taley a Jesús in conoyalchic: ―¿Jale’ a ulalchic abal a Cristo pel in tsacamil a David?
Ani a David im bijiy a Cristo tin Ajatic tam tin thucha’ al i Salmo antse’: A Dios in ucha’ u Ajatic: Quit buxcan tu huinab c’ubac.
Teje’ quit buxcan, ma nan tu pitha’its ta c’ubac a tomolnaxilchic abal ca tala’ ata’.
Cum antsana’ a David im bijiy a Cristo tin Ajatic, jaxtam i tso’obits abal yab pel in tsacamil a David.
Jolbix a Jesús c’al an exobchixchic c’al an ts’ejcath cau
Taley tin tamet patal an inicchic taja’, a Jesús in ucha’ in exobalilchic:

―Ca lej t’aja’chic ti cuenta yab ca t’aja’ jant’ini’ in t’ajal an exobchixchic c’al an ts’ejcath cau binath c’al a Moisés. In culbetnal ca xe’tsin c’al in nacat coton abal max ca tsu’tat ti pulic in ey. Jaye ca tsapnetha ti bel c’al yan i c’ac’naxtalab. Ti al an tiyopan in lej c’a’inchal ca buxcanchic jun ti quetel axi lej c’athpich pulic in ey, aniye jaye tam hua’ats i ajib ts’alat c’apuxtalab.

Bel c’al im pojcaxtal in tixc’anchal i c’alab an tsemchith uxumchic, ani talbelaquits u lej ohuelchic ti ol expith abal max ca tsu’tat ti t’ocat. Jats jaja’chic axi ne’ets ca c’athpich jolbiyat c’al a Dios.
